newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo aims 1.5 trln won chemical sales.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo aims 1.5 trln won chemical sales.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Corp, a unit of Daewoo Group, said on Monday it had targeted sales of 1.5 trillion won in the chemical sector in 2000.
Daewoo posted 570 billion won in sales from the sector in 1996.
A company statement said it planned to achieve the target by developing new markets, setting up overseas production and sales points and expanding overseas trading.

Daewoo also said it would boost chemical exports by increasing long term contracts for stable supply and developing existing markets in China and Southeast Asia and new markets in Latin America and Eastern Europe.
Daewoo said it expected chemical product exports to rise 28 percent to $770 million this year from last year, the statement said.
